items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: Benny Carter, we used to play all of his tunes.

ctx.x: Benny Carter, we used to play all of his tunes. That type of thing. Bill Doggett was very astute arranger at that period of time, and he reached out far for tunes to play for the band, and we were playing things that were different than anybody else.
Who were your soloists, do you remember.
